headline: God is Meaningful
subtitle: % who mentioned religion as a source of meaning in life (Pew 2021)
stat_label: Spirituality, faith and religion mentioned as a source of meaning
source_name: Pew Research Center: What Makes Life Meaningful? Views From 17 Advanced Economies (Spring 2021 Global Attitudes, Q36)
fun_fact: Americans stand out: 15% mentioned religion/God as a source of meaning — three times New Zealand (5%) and far above every other public surveyed (none above 5%).
